info.title: EcoPlug
info.description:
## EcoPlug API Collection

This collection covers the core backend API workflows for the **EcoPlug** platform — a system for managing EV charger infrastructure across companies and their employees.

### What's included

- **Health & Auth** — Health check, authentication verification (`Auth Check`), admin login, and employee login endpoints to validate service availability and manage access.
- **Company Management** — Register a company, view and manage the company profile, and handle admin-level operations.
- **Employee Management** — Create employees, retrieve employee profile data (`Employee Me`), and manage employee access levels.
- **Charger & Location Data** — Fetch data on chargers, their locations, and associated tariff information.

### Authentication

The collection uses JWT-based authentication. Multiple JWT tokens are stored as secret collection variables (e.g. `{{json_web_token_0v01}}`), supporting different user roles and access levels across requests.
